title: Grateful Dead Live at International Speedway on 1969-12-28
lineage: SBD > MC > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Raw, high‑energy 1969 Pig Pen showcase with scorching Mason’s Children, Hard to Handle and Lovelight, captured on a monitor‑mix soundboard that’s good but occasionally hot‑distorted or off‑speed.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this Miami‑Rock Festival performance as one of the most electrifying shows of ’69 – Pig Pen is in top form, Mason’s Children is called “the best ever,” and Hard to Handle and Lovelight are highlighted as show‑stoppers. The recording is a monitor‑mix soundboard that delivers plenty of excitement but suffers from occasional distortion, warble and speed issues, keeping the technical quality at a fair‑to‑good level.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews average 4.55 stars; overwhelming praise for the performance outweighs consistent but moderate complaints about distortion and pitch problems.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Monitor‑mix capture with moments of hot distortion when full band sings, occasional warble/pitch drift and an overall off‑speed feel; nonetheless the raw energy shines through.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Festival set with high‑octane Pig Pen numbers, explosive jams and abundant stage banter; a few songs feel truncated but the overall momentum stays relentless.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for ripping solos (e.g., on Mason's Children, Cold Rain and Snow) and delivering hard‑rock, gritty guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for strong bass lines and high harmonies that add to the “garage‑band” vibe.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pig Pen’s keyboards receive glowing remarks for energy and connection with the crowd; his presence is a highlight of the show.
